title: Pig eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#f9a8c9'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#fcc4dc'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#f9a8c9'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='34,22 30,10 44,18' fill='#f28ab3'/>
  <polygon points='66,22 70,10 56,18' fill='#f28ab3'/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <polygon points='36,21 33,14 42,19' fill='#fcc4dc'/>
  <polygon points='64,21 67,14 58,19' fill='#fcc4dc'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f27aa9'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c94f7c'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c94f7c'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='33' r='4' fill='#5cd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='4' fill='#5cd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='33' r='2' fill='#2a6f8f'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='2' fill='#2a6f8f'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='4' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='4' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#f28ab3'/>
  <rect x='61' y='80' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#f28ab3'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c94f7c'/>
  <rect x='61' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c94f7c'/>
  <!-- Tail curl -->
  <path d='M20 58 q-8 -2 -6 -8 q2 -6 8 -3' fill='none' stroke='#f28ab3' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Snack: cookie held near mouth -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='8' fill='#d69b5a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='55' r='1.6' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='55' r='1.4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- Bite crumbs -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='1.3' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='51' r='1.1' fill='#e8b878'/>
</svg>
